consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.title: audit finding - assurance activity of material unwanted event control at SG-7000

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control HAZARDOUS_AREA_EQUIPMENT_INTEGRITY: the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform, and the learning team review classified this as an individual or team action.
Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was not in place, and the learning team review classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on SG-7000 and record the assurance activity before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in maintaining protective systems, specifically inspecting and maintaining portable equipment. SG-7000 (terminal switchgear) is in service for terminal distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas was in place but did not perform. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 7 August 2024 a planned assurance activity of SG-7000 at Cape Verity Export Terminal found the integrity of explosion-protected equipment in zoned areas not effective.
